rules.text: A change to headings 7901 through 7902 from any other chapter
A change to subheading 7903.10 from any other chapter.
A change to subheading 7903.90 from and other heading.
A change to headings 7904 through 7905 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.

(A) A change to zinc tubes, pipes or tube or pipe fittings of heading 7907 from any other good of heading 7907 or any other heading; or
